note: Reference outputs are not stored here. The BF16 model's own greedy continuation is the reference, so the bank stays model-agnostic and does not go stale when the source checkpoint changes.

prompts.name: paris
prompts.rationale: Single-token factual recall. The canonical smoke test: if this diverges, the quantization broke something structural.

prompts.name: gsm8k-easy
prompts.rationale: One-step arithmetic. Sensitive to ffn_down and attn_output damage in the middle layers, which is where the gemma-4-12B divergence lived.

prompts.name: multi-turn
prompts.rationale: Four-message exchange with a system instruction. Exercises longer-context attention and instruction adherence rather than single-token recall.

prompts.name: code
prompts.rationale: Code completion. Empirically the first domain to degrade under aggressive quantization, and the one a factual smoke test misses.
